scope.description: Whole ffmpeg application/library breadth across useful functional families.
scope.denominator: Media demux/decode, filtering, editing, encode/mux, audio processing, subtitles, streaming and broad format/device support.

coverage.rationale: Connected video, audio and caption publication has grown, but general filter graphs, broad codecs, editing and streaming remain absent.

scope.description: Bounded image/video frame publication, review-movie audio/caption muxing and selected AAC/PCM audio interchange.
scope.denominator: User intent and domain decisions within the named supported workflows, including declared inputs, composition and useful outputs; excluded application features do not enter this score.

abstraction.rationale: Deliverable dimensions, duration/error/byte budgets and review-movie intent replace long command lines, while exact stream/container policies still matter.

limitations: Closed codecs, containers and bounded frame/audio contracts only; no arbitrary filters, streaming, audio mixing or general media editing; numeric error budgets are not perceptual quality.

Editorial estimate from current contracts, guidance and completion evidence; no exhaustive native API denominator or new native acceptance was measured for this assessment. Qualification and runtime availability must be queried separately.
